roles.why_relevant: This path matches strong interest in artificial intelligence, automation and practical problem solving. It builds on Python, SQL and analytical thinking while opening roles in product, research and technology teams.
roles.qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, AI, Data Science or related fields
responsibilities: Design and train machine learning models for real business problems
Clean and analyze structured and semi-structured data
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deploy AI features
Evaluate model quality and explain results to non-technical stakeholders
project_ideas: Build a customer churn prediction dashboard using a public dataset
Create a sentiment analysis tool for product reviews or customer feedback

roles.why_relevant: This role fits students who enjoy budgeting, analysis and financial markets while using Excel and communication skills. It builds on business understanding and numerical reasoning.
roles.qualification: B.Com, BBA, Finance or related undergraduate degree
responsibilities: Analyze financial statements and business performance
Prepare projections, reports and variance analysis
Support budgeting and investment decision-making
Present business insights to management teams
certifications: NSE Certified Investment and Financial Market Associate
project_ideas: Build a personal finance dashboard with budgeting and forecasting
Analyze a listed company and prepare a mini investment research report

roles.why_relevant: This path combines design thinking with engineering fundamentals. It matches students interested in vehicles, electric mobility and product design with a practical, systems-oriented mindset.
roles.qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical or Automobile Engineering
responsibilities: Create and refine vehicle components and assemblies
Work with design specifications and manufacturability constraints
Support prototyping and testing activities
Improve efficiency and safety in product design
project_ideas: Design a simple EV component or concept assembly using CAD software
Prepare a design notebook comparing conventional and electric vehicle architecture

roles.why_relevant: This path blends data, stakeholder communication and problem solving. It suits students with business communication, strategy interest and analytical thinking.
roles.qualification: MBA, BBA, B.Com or related management/business degree
responsibilities: Understand business problems and define solution requirements
Analyze operational and customer data to support decisions
Create dashboards and business presentations
Work with teams to improve processes and performance
project_ideas: Analyze an e-commerce funnel and propose process improvements
Create a KPI dashboard for a mock business problem

roles.why_relevant: This role is well suited for students who enjoy structured problem solving, dashboards and evidence-based decision making while using tools like Excel and SQL.
roles.qualification: Any undergraduate or postgraduate course with strong analytical aptitude
responsibilities: Collect, clean and organize business data
Create visual reports and dashboards for stakeholders
Interpret trends and summarize business insights
Support decision-making with analysis and recommendations
project_ideas: Create a sales dashboard using a public dataset
Perform exploratory analysis on student or campus performance data
